_comment: English words of the recognition score (intake/tools/ocr_score.py): two-letter words, units and chemical elements, triples of a letter that are no garbage (a web address); mixed_case_fix: a word of these letters with a capital after a lower-case letter is a word set in small caps that OCR read in both cases, made one case (assemble_md); off: the CamelCase of chemical formulas and names (NaHCO, McDonald) is kept; compound_links: the linking vowels of compound words, never a word of their own when a table cell whose spaces OCR lost is split into words (assemble_md).
